WITH rating_film_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS rented_films
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), rating_shares AS (
  SELECT rating, rented_films * 1.0 / SUM(rented_films) OVER () AS share
  FROM rating_film_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT rating, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM rating_shares
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share
